title: crataegus cordifolia var. macrosperma
intro: Crataegus cordifolia var. macrosperma, commonly known as Chinese Hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, native to China. The plant is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and polysaccharides. These compounds have been shown to exhibit cardiotonic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-diabetic properties, making Chinese Hawthorn a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular and metabolic disorders.
